market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Yields near 20-year highs and oil above $103 create headwinds for broad equities, but AI/tech leadership and China truce provide pockets of strength. Expect volatility around Fed commentary, UN speech, and energy supply headlines. 60/40 portfolios face 3-5% drawdown risk if yields push higher.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caveats. AI capex cycle and US-China trade normalization support equity growth through 2027. However, energy transition costs, persistent inflation from supply shocks, and geopolitical fragmentation cap upside. Favor quality, cash-generative names over high-multiple growth.
